sources.title: Yunlong Mountain
sources.excerpt: Yunlong Mountain (云龙山), located in southern Xuzhou, with an elevation of 142 m (466 ft), is the second tallest mountain in Xuzhou. Forests on the mountain cover an area of 509,944 square metres (5,488,990 sq ft). The forest coverage of Yunlong Mountain is 97.9 percent. The dense tree coverage attracts tourists, who enjoy the view of clouds surrounding the peaks all year round. With its nine dragon-like peaks, from southeast to northwest, it is like a giant dragon being overlooked, from which it got its name 'Yunlong'.
